sections.Profile:
The Six Million Dollar Man pinball machine, produced by Bally in 1978, is themed after the popular TV series featuring the bionic man, Colonel Steve Austin. Designed by Greg Kmiec with artwork by Dave Christensen, this solid-state machine accommodates up to six players, which was unique for its time.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 6
- Tags: Fictional Character, Licensed, 1970s, Solid State, TV Show
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Greg Kmiec
- Art: Dave Christensen
